detaileddescription.para:
Saves the character to file. If being saved asynchronously, the returned save object will be the updated object as it is right before the save writes to file. Triggers 'OnCharacterSaved' upon completion (async or not).
SaveObject
The save data being carried between child/parent
bRunAsync
True if the save should run asynchronously
The USavedCharacter SaveGame object for this character.

Processes loading a character from a save. Does not work if 'bCharacterRestored' is already set. Will not run if the character has not initialized. Internally calls 'OnCharacterRestored' after load data has been processed. The SlotName and UserIndex is only used by the async delegate. If LoadCharacter is called manually, these values will not be
used and are obtained from the ATalesGameState.
SlotName
The save name to be restored. Only set in async call. Ignored if called manually.
UserIndex
The user index for the character. Only set in async call. Ignored if called manually.
SaveGame
When used as an async load delegate, this is the save object loaded.
